name: @arcdrop/api
description: ArcDrop API — NestJS REST API running on Bun

scripts.build: bun build ./src/main.ts ./src/database/data-source.cli.ts ./src/scripts/backfill-metadata.ts --outdir dist --target bun --external '@nestjs/*' --external reflect-metadata --external rxjs --external express --external typeorm --external pg --external ws --external '@modelcontextprotocol/*' --external class-validator-jsonschema
scripts.migration:run: bun run build && bun node_modules/typeorm/cli.js migration:run -d dist/database/data-source.cli.js
scripts.migration:revert: bun run build && bun node_modules/typeorm/cli.js migration:revert -d dist/database/data-source.cli.js
scripts.migration:generate: bun run build && bun node_modules/typeorm/cli.js migration:generate -d dist/database/data-source.cli.js
